content: NIST SP 800-63B-4 requires single-use expiring out-of-band secrets and rate limiting; generating another secret must not reset failed-attempt count. PSTN delivery is restricted and number changes bind a new authenticator. Lafu inference: OTP proves current number control, not permanent customer identity; normalize numbers and protect recovery, admin role assignment and message-spend limits. WhatsApp provider policy needs separate research. https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-4/sp800-63b.html
